hooks.command: filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '(node_modules/|bun\.lock)'; then echo 'BLOCK: Do not edit generated files (node_modules, bun.lock)' >&2; exit 2; fi

filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -f "$filepath" ]; then if echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '\.md$'; then bunx prettier --write --prose-wrap always "$filepath" 2>/dev/null; elif echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json)$'; then bunx biome format --write "$filepath" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi; exit 0
